en: Vintage sepia postcard showing loggers cutting down enormous conifer trees in a forest. Several men work in pairs with long crosscut saws at the bases of the trunks, with more trees and forest in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Destroying the Giants." Vertical text along the left margin mentions printing in Germany and being hand colored, and along the right margin identifies the publisher in Los Angeles, California.
